lines.zh: 我飘着走，脚不沾地，像团棉花。
lines.en: I drift without touching the ground, like cotton.

lines.zh: 我身上毛茸茸的，像团棉花。
lines.en: I'm fluffy, like a tuft of cotton.
I drift a block, then pause.
A gust carries me off.
I needn't walk. Drifting works.

lines.zh: 我飘过草尖，草被压了一下。
lines.en: I drift over grass and it bends.
I drift and spin a little.
I'm so light I leave no prints.
I drift slowly to your side.
I don't float high. One block.
I ride the wind out and back.
Drifting, I'm very quiet.
I hover, rising and falling.

lines.zh: 我身上的绒毛一直在抖。
lines.en: My fluff keeps trembling.
I'm waiting for someone to care for me.
I'm tiny. I can't do anything.
I float by a flower and watch.
I curl into a soft little ball.
Sunlight passes through my fluff.
I hang there, my fluff trembling in layers.

lines.zh: 我是一团绒毛，风一吹就飘。
lines.en: A ball of fluff, drifting on the wind.
I'm listening to the wind.

lines.zh: 我这团绒里，藏着一根芽。
lines.en: A sprout hides in this fluff.
Safe here. I'm not afraid.
I turn slowly with the wind.
I hover at the door and have not moved.
You came; I have waited long enough.
I stop at the height of your eyes.
I can't raise my head. I only look up.
Picking me up? I'm very light.
I circle once by your hand.
I drift a little toward your hand.
I float half way around you.
So small — can you see me?
I rock gently.
I don't understand what you say.

lines.zh: 我飘高了一点，跟你平视。
lines.en: I rise a little to your eye level.

lines.zh: 躲到你身后，别把我推出去。
lines.en: I hide behind you, do not push me out.

lines.zh: 我一身细绒毛，风一吹就飘。
lines.en: All fine fuzz; one breeze carries me.

lines.zh: 一两点血的幼体，飘着走。
lines.en: One or two health, drifting along.
I drift close, then back.
You smile and I bob twice.
I curl up and can't drift.
The blow knocked me swinging.
I hide behind you.
Half my fluff is ruffled.
I can still drift. Just slowly.
That dropped me a block.
My fluff is mussed; I smooth it slowly.
I'm too small. Please stop.
I pull in tight and go quiet.
Pat me and I'll be all right.
Food. I smell it.
I drift over. Slowly.

lines.zh: 你指头尖上的碎屑给我。
lines.en: Give me the crumbs on your fingertip.
I float like a tuft of fluff.
Any more? I'd like some.
I float up, then sink back down.
I float to your hand and wait.
That smell is unfamiliar.
Done. I rock a little.
I'll just smell it.
Not edible. I drift back.

lines.zh: 你留着吧，我这团绒毛吃不了它。
lines.en: Keep it; this fuzzball cannot eat it.
I bump and drift away.
The bump turned me upside down.
Sorry. I can't drift straight.
I'm so light. One touch moves me.
I drift back slowly.
That ruffled all my fluff.

lines.zh: 我身上毛茸茸的，飘到叶子后面。
lines.en: Fluffy all over, I drift behind a leaf.
Don't touch me. I'll drift off.
I hover and steady myself.
I rock a bit. Fine.
I'm too small for this.
I float, leaning on you.

lines.zh: 你坐着，我就飘在你旁边。
lines.en: You sit; I float nearby.
I press my fluff to your hand.
I make no sound. I only sway.
Touch me and I hold still.
I fell asleep floating above your head.
I dreamed I was bigger.
I wake with my fluff flattened.

lines.zh: 等我变成别的样子，还认得你。
lines.en: When I change shape, I will still know you.
I wrap it in my fluff.
A baby-stage mouth — this is edible.

lines.zh: 这块硬东西蹭着我的嘴。
lines.en: This hard thing rubs against my mouth.
I lift it and float up.
I wrap around it and cannot rise.
I can't hold it. It falls.

lines.zh: 它在我的绒毛里不晃了。
lines.en: Inside my fluff it stops rattling.
I carry it two blocks.
I catch it up in my fluff.
I hold it and drift slowly.

lines.zh: 有东西来了，我飘高一点。
lines.en: Something's coming. I float higher.
Like a puffball, I curl up and stay.
I drift behind you.
I can't call out. I only rock.
It is ten times my size; I shrink down.
I drift under a leaf.
I wait for you to come find me.
I'm ready to drift away.
I dare not even stir my fluff.
If it comes close, I drift off.
I'm shaking. My fluff shakes too.

lines.zh: 我听到你的声音就飘过去。
lines.en: I drift toward the sound of your voice.
If I move, it will look this way.
It goes left; I drift right.
I press against your shoulder.
I drift a little further off.
I pull my fluff in tight.
I drift behind a tree.
Fluff covers my whole body.
I shrink into the shadow of a leaf vein.
I hover without moving.
Reach out and I'll drift to you.
I hide in your shadow.
If it moves, I flee.
I spit a string of bubbles at it.
I bump into it. Almost no force.
That drifted me away instead.
No teeth. Only bumping.

lines.zh: 泡泡破了，什么都没留下。
lines.en: The bubble pops. Nothing left.
Afterward I drift behind you.
I bump it and drift away myself.
I rock, then stop.
One sweep from it and I'm carried off.
I hide and stop fighting.
I'm too small. This is all.
Pat me and I won't be afraid.
The shell cracks and I float out.

lines.zh: 我先飘起来，才看清周围。
lines.en: I float up first, then look around.

lines.zh: 我从蛋壳里滚出来，飘起。
lines.en: I roll from the eggshell and float up.
My fluff is still damp.
I drift a block and stop.

lines.zh: 这里有吃的味道，飘着的。
lines.en: Something edible smells here — drifting.
I raise my head to the sun.
A ball of fluff, floating in the air.
I rock a little and wait.
I'll grow. Soon.
I drift slowly to your hand.
Small as I am, I'm worth a look.

lines.zh: 火一近，我的绒毛就卷了。
lines.en: Fire comes close and my fluff curls.
I fall, but slowly.

lines.zh: 水一泡，我就轻飘飘地沉。
lines.en: Soaked, I sink gently.
The blast throws me up into the treetops.

lines.zh: 东西穿过绒毛，扎到了我。
lines.en: It goes through my fluff and stings.
Light binds me and I can't drift.
Too hungry to float.
Lightning goes through me; my fluff singes.
Nothing below. I keep falling.
